Name: Dark Club - Lewd Fruit Gift Dialogue Expansion
Author: nocrash99
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Adds heart-based gift reactions and gift taste changes for the four lewd fruits from Dark Club (Tits Apple, Dick Banana, Butt Peach, and Nuts Cherry).[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]The same fruit gives completely different dialogue depending on your relationship with the character — from disgusted refusal at low hearts to explicit and intimate lines once you are close or married. Gift tastes also change with friendship level.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Two editions are available. Install only one:[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Vanilla Gender: All characters are written according to their original gender.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Genderswap: The six original bachelors are written as female (for use with female portrait / genderswap mods).[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Bilingual (English + Chinese). The game language determines which text you see.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Installation instructions[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Install Dark Club.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Download and unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Important: There are two editions of this mod. Install only one. They use the same dialogue keys and will conflict if both are installed.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Heart-based gift reactions for four lewd fruits (Tits Apple, Dick Banana, Butt Peach, Nuts Cherry).
Four relationship tiers:
Stranger (0–2 hearts): Disliked, loses friendship, disgusted/refusal dialogue.
Familiar (3–6 hearts): Neutral, awkward or curious dialogue.
Close (7+ hearts, not married): Liked, gains friendship, flirty dialogue.
Spouse (Married): Loved, gains the most friendship, explicit intimate dialogue.
Gift tastes change automatically with friendship level.
Bilingual support (English + Chinese).
Optional support for Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, and East Scarp characters.
Vanilla Gender edition and Genderswap edition available (choose one).

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Required:
SMAPI
Content Patcher
Dark Club 
Optional (for extra characters):
Stardew Valley Expanded
Ridgeside Village
East Scarp

For the Genderswap edition (recommended):
If you are using the Genderswap edition, you should also install:
Bountiful Beauties Vol. 2 - Mud's Skimpy Anime Portraits (Bachelor Genderswaps) by Mud (for female portraits of the original bachelors)
A dialogue and name change mod, such as Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes with SVE Support (to match pronouns, dialogue, and names)
OO's Anime Style Skimpy Portraits for SVE
OO's Anime Style Skimpy Portraits
Notes:
Install only one edition (Vanilla Gender or Genderswap).
The heart tier is checked when the save loads. Reload your save after crossing a heart threshold for the new reactions to take effect.
Adult content. Dialogue is explicit.
